name: helper-catalog-eligibility
goal: Only pure functions with two distinct runtime consumers appear under Helpers; private functions remain accessible from owners without a Helpers breadcrumb

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Use purity plus two distinct runtime consumers for Helpers membership; retain private function detail/history access from owner without a Helpers breadcrumb.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Catalog tests already exclude single consumers, but classification and private detail navigation were untested. Extend existing category/entity tests and the helper grid revision/viewport matrix to cover owner links and breadcrumbs.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Final frozen corpus 8ffed2f7 fails Private functions have no Helpers breadcrumb at desktop, tablet and mobile in the full 65-case browser command. All supporting fixtures and vocabulary corrections were committed before repair.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Apply existing helperContract to classification, resolve private callable detail pages explicitly, link private dependencies from Uses and name the sole owner in breadcrumbs.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Final frozen test corpus 8ffed2f7 fails private breadcrumbs before repair. Separate fix f57310b1 passes the identical full command: all 65 browser cases and 26 focused unit checks.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Reports bun run check passes on f57310b1: format, Svelte types, lint, 604 unit tests, application/report/console builds and audit. Frozen green passes 65 browser cases and 26 focused unit tests. Twenty-five contract/import/index guard tests pass; root audit and registry have no errors (64 existing uncertain references). Actual committed registry has 6 eligible helper owners and 10 exports; Activity freshness is absent from Helpers, its owner Uses link works, desktop/mobile screenshots inspected, no browser console errors. Root aggregate stopped during unit tests after separately reproducing the pre-existing hooks fixture mismatch (expected source bytes 87/148, actual 100/161); remaining broad root layers are not complete. Report remains active and unpublished; no app deployment.
